title: DoggCrapp Training - BE Version
author: Barry E.
desc:
A high-intensity, low-volume hypertrophy program from Dante Trudel. You hit each body part with one hard rest-pause set, rotate exercises, and chase weight on the bar every session. Built for blast-and-cruise cycling, not endless grinding.

I've taken Dante's template and added a fourth cycle plus inserted 2 weeks of deload in between each 6 week cycle.
